description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Serco Inc. is hiring a Software Engineer to support Naval Surface Warfare Center Panama City Division programs for autonomous maritime systems. The role develops and implements software applications for unmanned systems and supports software installation and testing.
Software engineer supporting application installation, systems development, and software testing certification

Responsibilities:
• Be familiar with the principles, practices, and procedures used in software and systems development
• Support and/or install software applications/operating systems
• Participate in the testing process through test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of software
• Be familiar with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within a particular field
• Rely on limited experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals
• Performs additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management
• Must be continuously flexible to changing requirements

Requirements:
• Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Interim Secret or Secret clearance
• U.S Citizenship required
• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related degree
• Or a High School Diploma/GED with minimum 5 years of relevant work experience
• Minimum 0-1 year of directly related work/internship/project experience
• Proficiency in key Microsoft Office applications is required to include Word, Excel, and Outlook

Preferred:
• Background in DOD contracting is preferred
• Experience in programming languages such as Python, C++, and Java
• Excellent organization, communication, and interpersonal relationships with coworkers and customers
• A Secret level security clearance
